title: River Ganga basin map
subject: Geography
caption: Map of the Ganga River basin highlighting tributaries, cultural sites, agricultural areas, and ecological hotspots.
altText: A photorealistic textbook‑style map on a white background showing the Ganga River flowing from the Himalayas to the Bay of Bengal. Major tributaries such as the Yamuna, Ghaghara, Gandak, Kosi, and Son are traced in blue. Surrounding regions are shaded to indicate agricultural zones (green), ecological hotspots (yellow), and cultural heritage sites (red markers) including Varanasi, Haridwar, and Patna. The map includes a legend, scale bar, north arrow, and clear labels for rivers, cities, and zones, providing an accurate visual overview of the basin's geography and cultural significance.
